questions.question: A car is purchased for $20,000. It depreciates in value by 10% per annum. What is its value after 2 years?
A machine worth $5,000 depreciates at a constant compound rate. After 2 years, its value is $4,050. What is the annual rate of depreciation?
The population of a town is 10,000. It decreases by 5% each year. What is the population after 3 years? (Round to nearest whole number)
A vehicle's value is $12,150 after 2 years of depreciating at 10% per annum. What was its original purchase price?
An asset worth $10,000 depreciates at 20% per annum. After how many full years will its value drop below $5,000?
A radioactive substance decays by 15% every hour. If the initial mass is 200g, what is the mass remaining after 2 hours?
Which formula represents the value A of an asset after n years if it depreciates by r% per annum from an initial value P?
questions.explanation: Compound decrease uses the formula A = P(1 - r/100)^n, where r is the rate of depreciation.

questions.question: A smartphone loses 25% of its value each year. If it was bought for $800, what is its value after 1.5 years? (Assume continuous compounding formula not required, use standard compound decay)
